text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
――Now, the decisive moment!!
Every Umamusume is making their final spurt!!

text_block_list.name: Bubble & Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ““————HAAAAAAAHHHH!!!””

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Who will it be?! Bubble?! Or Air?!
Bubble?! Or Air?!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: (————Thank you, Air Groove...!)

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: IT STARTS FROM HEEEEEERE!!!!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
—It's Bubble! It's Bubble!!
It's Bubble Gum Fellow!!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: Bubble Gum Fellow crosses the finish line!!!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
A historic first!! She's achieved
back-to-back Tenno Sho (Autumn) victoooories!!!!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOOOOH!!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: —Alright!!!

text_block_list.name: Race Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Whoaaa!! Back-to-back victories two years in a row!!
Bubble Gum Fellow really is the best ever--!!

text_block_list.name: Race Fan B
text_block_list.text:
That's Bubble Gum Fellow of the "Four Heavenly Kings" for you...!
Her strength from the Takarazuka Kinen is still going strong...!!

text_block_list.name: Race Fan C
text_block_list.text:
"Man, Air Groove was incredible too, though.
At this rate, a Tiara Umamusume winning the Tenno Sho (Autumn) next year is seriously possible...!"

text_block_list.name: Race Fan D
text_block_list.text:
Wait, if they race next time,
Air Groove might actually win, right...!?
Aaah~ now I really wanna cheer for her...!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ――...Splendid.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"You are strong, just as I thought.
Once again... I've been made keenly aware of it."

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: Air Groove—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Your running roared that there are no limits.
I learned a lot from you.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Be prepared.
Next time, things will not go as they did today.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: ...Haha—

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
It was thanks to you that I was reminded once again
that there are no limits,
Air Groove.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Because you were truly strong today...
I was able to find strength in the clutch as well.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: (Yes, I understand now—)

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
(We walked different paths, only to cross
here today at the Tenno Sho (Autumn)—)

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
(What we hold in our hearts...
What we are trying to carve open...
Must surely be so similar.)

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
(An unseen strength. Potential. The future.
And the will to forge ahead toward it—)

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: (Because we're similar... I will——)

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: (That burning desire not to lose flared up inside me...!)

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: (I got more fired up than ever before...!!)

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ...Very well.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
If you intend to keep pushing endlessly forward,
then I have no choice but to blow past you even further ahead.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: —The Japan Cup.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: That is my next battlefield.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
If we cross paths—
next time, we will win.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer,
what did you think of Air Groove today?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Bubble Gum Fellow was able to defeat Air Groove today.
However—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Racing fans are watching with great anticipation.
They look forward to Air Groove's future runs, showing off new possibilities.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Coincidentally...
It mirrored the time Bubble Gum Fellow challenged the Tenno Sho (Autumn) as a Classic-class runner.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: "You know, I realized something too. Air Groove and I actually have a lot in common."

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
And... that's precisely why—
I have to pull ahead of Air Groove.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: Only by achieving a complete victory over her can I truly become the "vanguard" and forge ahead past everyone else.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
I can reach an unseen strength
that will turn the racing world upside down...!
choice_data_list: Then let's go. To the Japan Cup...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The race of fated rivals, where Bubble Gum Fellow
had felt such bitter disappointment last year.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, she will achieve a decisive victory over a fellow trailblazer—the one she must surpass now...!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: —I've popped off to the absolute max...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, Bubble Gum Fellow's next goal was set
as the Japan Cup—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: ――At a later date.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: Hey, Air Groove.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Good work.
Care for some coffee today?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Yeah.
I've got student council duties to attend to as well.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
You really are a hard worker.
I think I'll go with orange juice today.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: ...... I'm going to the 『Japan Cup』.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ...I already said my piece.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Yeah.
So next, it's our turn.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: ――I'll beat you.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: Let's settle this, Air Groove.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Bring it on, Bubble.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
No one else heard that quiet exchange.
Time simply marched on toward the decisive battle—
